text.title: API Versioning Decision Tree
text.summary: Two routing trees mapping observable signals to a rule from content/01-core-rules.xml: the breaking/additive classifier that decides whether to version at all, and the scheme classifier that decides how the version is carried. The skip-this-methodology branch is always reachable.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the pending change a breaking semantic change?

conclusion.verdict: ship as additive in current major version; no bump
use @deprecated + persisted queries; load graphql-api-design instead
create vN+1 in a separate module; mark vN deprecated

section.title: Breaking-vs-additive classifier
section.p: Run this before the root question above; it is what produces change_kind. Any single breaking signal makes the whole change breaking — signals do not average out.

decision-tree.root-question: Which signals does the spec diff carry?

conclusion.verdict: change_kind=breaking; major bump — this is the case most often misread as additive
change_kind=additive; minor bump, no deprecation window

section.title: Version-scheme classifier
section.p: Runs once per API, not once per change. Once the scheme is chosen it is recorded in info.x-versioning and never mixed with another.

decision-tree.root-question: Who consumes the API and how strictly do they negotiate content?

conclusion.verdict: verdict=fail; move the version out of the body before choosing a scheme
verdict=fail; pick one scheme and enforce it with a Spectral rule
scheme=url-path; cache-friendly and debuggable in the address bar
scheme=header-key; keeps the public URL surface stable

section.title: Deprecation-window gate
section.p: Applies only after the classifier returned change_kind=breaking and a vN+1 was decided.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the declared deprecation window long enough for this audience?

conclusion.verdict: verdict=fail; extend the window to >= 90 days
verdict=fail; extend the window to >= 30 days
verdict=pass; emit Deprecation/Sunset/Link and ship the plan

text.example: openapi diff shows 1 BREAKING (removed field email_verified) → decision=vN+1 → copy /api/v1/users handler to /api/v2/users with the field removed → mark v1 route deprecated in ops/sunset.yaml → measure traffic → 410 Gone on sunset date → delete handler after 30d zero traffic.

POST /charges gains a required amount field → classifier branch optional_field_became_required → change_kind=breaking → scheme classifier: public audience → url-path → v1→v2 → window 180 days >= 90 → pass; sunset_date = today + 180.
